title: Stories and science
info: Astronomy measures the sky and keeps ideas that survive tests. Astrology says the positions of the Sun and planets at a birth describe people or predict events.
Stars in a constellation are usually not neighbors in space. They only line up in our view.
Earth's axis slowly wobbles, a motion called precession, about once every 26,000 years. Because of that, the constellation behind the Sun on a given date slowly changes.
Many horoscopes use a tropical zodiac tied to the seasons, not to the constellation the Sun is actually in. Ophiuchus is another constellation on the Sun's real path.
A vague sentence can feel true for almost anyone. That feeling is not a scientific test. Star stories can still be wonderful art and history.
